note: Prototype household data. The recording does not show these details; they stand in for what scene understanding and personal memory would provide.

weather.description: Mock weather by date, temperature, rain, wind, snow, forecast; useful for outdoor plans.

storage.description: Objects, food inventory, supplies, belongings, locations, drawers, fridge, laundry and appliance state.

user_events.description: Calendar, recurring activities, badminton, meetings, hangouts, hiking and availability.

personal.description: User preferences, daily routines, recent activity and current activity. Includes the current reading book, page progress and approximate story checkpoint.
